messages:
marie (Design): quick design review — proposing a 'mini-compare' overlay that appears on hover for rows in the model catalog. Goal: let people add models to the compare view without navigating away. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/mini-compare (low-fi). Main asks: accessibility (keyboard & screen reader), copy for the action, and how badges behave when multiple metrics stack.

kevin (PM): I like the flow, but discoverability is a concern — hover-only is invisible to keyboard users. Suggest we also surface the action in the row 'more' menu. Also—what do we call it? 'Pin' vs 'Compare' vs 'Add to compare'?

sarah (Frontend): implementation notes: make it a button (not just hover area) so keyboard users can trigger. Proposed HTML snippet: 
```html
<button aria-label="Add model to compare" class="mini-compare-btn" aria-pressed="false">Add</button>
```
We'll need aria-live updates when the compare panel changes.

oliver (Eng-ML): backend is straightforward — same /compare/add endpoint works. Make the action idempotent and emit telemetry event `catalog_pin` with model_id + version. If we expect bulk actions, consider batching.

marie (Design): Copy thoughts — options we tried: 'Pin to compare' (explicit), 'Add to compare' (neutral), 'Snapshot' (ambiguous). My preference for the row action: 'Add to compare'. Use 'Pinned' as the state label.

kevin (PM): 'Add to compare' reads clearer to me. Also badge tooltip microcopy: instead of long phrase use `Latency (p99): 120 ms` or `Quality: 87%` — concise and scannable.

sarah (Frontend): accessibility nits I already caught: focus ring should be >=3px and color #005FCC to meet contrast. Small badges (12px) currently fail contrast — WCAG says 4.5:1 for normal text but small text needs higher; either increase bg contrast or bump text weight/size. Also ensure the overlay is reachable via keyboard: tabindex=0 on row and `Enter`/`Space` opens overlay.

marie (Design): I can update palette and badge states. Keyboard shortcut idea: press `c` to toggle compare when a row is focused — but we must check global shortcut conflicts. Will add ephemeral tooltip on focus: 'Press C to add to compare'.

design-bot: Snapshot posted — figma://file/mini-compare-v2 (updated copy + accessibility notes). @kevin please confirm the analytics events and event names.

oliver (Eng-ML): UX edge-case: if users pin models across versions, we should show version metadata inline: e.g., 'Pinned: v2.1' and provide a small chevron to roll-forward or 'follow latest'. Otherwise people get confused when compare results don't match production. Recommend server returns `pinned_version` and `is_following_latest`.

kevin (PM): +1. Microcopy for that menu: 'Pin version' / 'Follow latest' / 'Roll forward to vX'. Keep it short.

marie (Design): I'll incorporate the version chip and menu into the mock, update badge contrast, and add keyboard flows. Plan to push final mocks + spec by EOD Thursday. :calendar:

sarah (Frontend): sounds good — I'll prototype keyboard semantics and aria-live wording after mocks land. :thumbsup:

kevin (PM): thanks team — marking this as design-review in progress. Please add comments on the figma file.
